key.name: ctrlv-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut that opens and closes the popup

key.name: takeover-shortcut
key.summary: Take the shortcut from GNOME's notification list
key.description: GNOME opens the notification list with Super+V and Super+M. While the extension is on, it keeps only the accelerators that don't clash with ours. Nothing is written to GNOME's settings.

key.name: history-size
key.summary: Number of items to keep, not counting pins

key.name: persist-history
key.summary: Keep the history after a restart
key.description: When off, only pinned items survive a restart, as on Windows.

key.name: excluded-apps
key.summary: App IDs whose copies are never recorded

key.name: terminal-apps
key.summary: App IDs that paste with Ctrl+Shift+V
